text: This staff report is a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to amend the current traffic and parking regulations on St. Helen’s Avenue and Whytock Avenue, as it relates to the development of No. 138 St. Helen’s Avenue. The proposed traffic and parking amendments will address requirements of the site plan agreement, particularly with regards to safe turning movements of large vehicles accessing the site.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Enacted a one-way eastbound operation on Whytock Avenue, between St. Helen’s Avenue and the first lane east of St. Helen’s Avenue. 2. Prohibited stopping at all times on the west side of St. Helen’s Avenue, between Whytock Avenue and a point 25 metres north. 3. Amended the existing permit parking in effect from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., daily, on the even side of St. Helen’s Avenue, between Whytock Avenue and Dublin Street, to be in effect between Dublin Street and a point 25 metres north of Whytock Avenue. 4. Amended the existing one-hour parking regulation in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of St. Helen's Avenue, between a point 104 metres south of Dublin Street and Whytock Avenue, to be in effect from a point 104 metres south of Dublin Street to a point 25 metres north of Whytock Avenue.
